title: Settlement strand-braid cultural fabric
scope: Qualitative strand-braid cultural fabric and layered System-practice variation for the mixed refuge settlement; usable for culture, daily-rhythm, institutional, and story development without establishing names, languages, faith content, demographics, rituals, governance terms, protagonist facts, harvest institutions, settlement-zone placement, or any change to natural System behaviour.
claims: Several persistent origin strands coexist in the settlement, keeping distinct household-level traditions — foodways, teaching lines, memory-keeping, work customs — while sharing negotiated common institutions for work, defence, and festivals; no strand dissolves and no strand dominates.

The strand classes include, non-exhaustively: locally rooted pre-collapse families; displaced arrivals from failed districts; ex-imperial functionary or garrison descendants; and itinerant-craft or trade lineages; households may straddle classes by marriage or fostering.

Routine cross-strand crewing exists for lake-road haulage within WLD-LOCATION-002's fair-weather bands and for corridor-season watches and closures under WLD-ECOLOGY-004; in surge seasons mixed crews are the negotiated, deliberate compact-era custom, not an arithmetic necessity.
Settlement festivals keyed to the seasonal rhythms are common institutions with distinguishable strand contributions.

Views of the imperial inheritance form a lived spectrum — salvage-pragmatism, nostalgia, resentment, taboo — distributed across and within strands, with strand-level leanings but no single settlement attitude and no strand unanimity.
System practice varies by class of use — everyday pragmatic use, hoarded craft advantage, specialist study, and folk belief and misinterpretation — cross-cutting the strands.

No strand, cluster, lineage, or specialist holds exclusive or complete System truth; every System-practice claim in this record is cultural — records, access, belief, interpretation, presentation — and none alters natural System behaviour.

The settlement is and remains a mixed refuge community of 1,200–2,000 under the founder's dynasty and council compact, with the first succession approaching (capture-settled; restated, not re-litigated).
Literacy and historical memory exist in the settlement but are uneven — across strands, households, generations, and professions — consistent with the capture's dark-age-not-absence framing.
Every strand class remains open as a possible protagonist origin.
boundaries: This record is a forward culture extension filling WLD-LOCATION-001's declared culture-and-institution opening; it does not alter the accepted geography, ecology, location, or travel records, and every open boundary of every record it touches stays open.

Strand, braid, class, crew, watch, festival, lore, and every other label in this record are author-facing qualitative descriptions; they fix no in-world name, language, classification, ritual content, institution, office, law, measurement, proportion, or performance guarantee.

The strand classes are qualitative classes, not named cultures, and the class list is open-ended; no demographic percentage, strand proportion, household count, or settlement-interior arrangement is established, and WLD-RARITY-001D's deferral of universal proportions stands.
No strand is selected as the protagonist's origin; every strand class remains open for the series contract to choose later, and no protagonist fact of any kind is established.

WLD-CULTURE-002 owns the founder-council compact's structure, offices, decision classes, representation, and succession provisions; this record restates the compact's existence without re-litigating it and establishes only that watch duty exists and is crewed across strands, while command, levy authority, and any watch-related office or obligation remain WLD-CULTURE-002's territory and no governance claim, law code, or compact term is fixed here.

Declared qualitative closure of WLD-ECOLOGY-004's open practice space: corridor-season watch duty exists as a routine practice; exact route geography, dates, rosters, warning methods, barriers, compensation, and emergency procedures remain open, and no field or road is identified as a secondary-path overlap.

Declared qualitative closure of WLD-LOCATION-002's open customary-practice space: a routine cross-strand haulage crewing custom exists; its exact form, schedule, convoy arrangement, toll, and authority remain open, and WLD-LOCATION-002 remains the sole authority for its broad fair-weather whole-journey bands, which this record does not divide, extend, shorten, or recalculate.

WLD-ECOLOGY-006 continues to establish human exploitation of the spring abundance pulse as a mortality channel only; in this record the pulse appears solely as prose-level labour pressure, no crewing, worker role, technique, harvest rule, fishing institution, law, ownership, trade, ritual, preservation method, sustainable rate, or shore institution is established, and harvest institutions of every kind remain open.

No strand, cluster, or household is assigned to any particular field, road, spur, zone, or water source, and no structure, worker role, schedule, or shore institution is placed at WLD-LOCATION-003's staging place or spurs.
WLD-GEOGRAPHY-001's qualitative seasonal texture motivates the seasonal labour rhythms; no climate value, calendar, or map is fixed.
Festivals are keyed to the seasonal rhythms, but no festival calendar, date, observance content, ritual, costume, foodway detail, craft, or teaching institution is established.

The imperial-inheritance spectrum is attitude only; WLD-HISTORY-001 establishes the qualitative collapse chronology and bounded neighbor frame, this record adds no historical phase, cause, date, name, or event, no attitude here is evidence of what actually occurred, and no imperial work, record, or site is identified or characterised.

Every System-practice claim sits on the records, access, belief, interpretation, or presentation layer; natural System behaviour is unchanged, no readout is guaranteed, no appraisal is omniscient, no notification is universal, and no strand's, lineage's, or specialist's account is privileged or complete (CAL0 UI1.0D, UI1.1D, UI1.2D).

Hoarded craft advantage is hoarded access and interpretation, not better natural law; which advantages are hoarded, by whom, and their real versus believed efficacy remain open, specialist study yields fallible theory, and folk belief may be wrong — and often is.

No institution gains System-executed power (CAL0 SOC1.2D), no eligibility-by-category belief is promoted to fact (CAL0 WLD1.1D), no age- or level-band progression is implied (CAL0 WLD2.2D), and awakening, coming-of-age, and guardianship customs remain open (CAL0 WLD1.0D topology unapplied).
No named culture, language, faith content, or self-designation is established; all in-world names and linguistic logic remain protected unknowns.

Uneven literacy and historical memory establish no archive, school, record content, or record accuracy; WLD-ECOLOGY-005 continues to govern provenance, all life referenced is local, reported traveller knowledge proves nothing about nonlocal existence or presence, and no import, product, or traveller-carried organism is established.

The fabric is author-side cultural truth as a pattern; a character knows another strand's customs, another household's lore, or the distribution of attitudes only through an available source, and no character surveys the whole fabric.

Cross-strand acquaintance and obligation networks, quiet inequality from hoarded advantage, and plausible record disputes are standing pressures at story start, not occurred events; no incident, dispute, festival occurrence, or succession event is established.

No new System mechanic, readout, or CAL0 change is created; no WLD-SOUL, WLD-PRENATAL, or other project default is adopted; and the parked sapient pack species remains parked, with no biology, culture, or ability development.
story_implications: Later scenes may use strand-distinct households, mixed crews, common festivals, attitude conflicts, and varied System lore, but every particular household, custom, festival occurrence, dispute, belief, and outcome requires its own evidence.

Cross-strand acquaintance and obligation networks, quiet inequality from hoarded craft advantage, and plausible record disputes are standing pressures the approaching first succession will stress, not occurred events.
Every strand class remains an open possible protagonist origin for the series contract to choose later.
The fabric does not become automatic character knowledge; a character knows another strand's customs, lore, or attitudes only through an available source.
system_implications: The selected fabric is an ordinary setting extension; all practice classes are cultural layers — records, access, belief, interpretation, presentation — over unchanged natural System behaviour under CAL0 UI1.0D and UI1.2D.

No appraisal is omniscient and no notification universal (CAL0 UI1.1D); no institution gains System-executed power (CAL0 SOC1.2D); no eligibility-by-category belief becomes fact (CAL0 WLD1.1D); no age- or level-band progression is implied (CAL0 WLD2.2D); awakening customs remain open (CAL0 WLD1.0D).
No CAL0 change, new System mechanic, readout guarantee, or project-default adoption is created.
research_questions: What in-world names, languages, and linguistic logic should later name the strands, festivals, institutions, and lores?
Which strand constituencies, representation pressures, and designed compact ambiguities matter to the approaching first succession within WLD-CULTURE-002's accepted structure?
Which strand class, if any, does the protagonist originate from, and what does the series contract choose generally?
What faith content, cosmology, awakening and coming-of-age customs, and guardianship practices exist (CAL0 WLD1.0D topology available but unapplied)?
What specific festival calendars, ritual content, foodways, costume, crafts, and teaching institutions can the fabric support?
What actual demographic composition, strand sizes, household counts, and settlement-interior arrangement can support the qualitative pattern?
What is the content of specialist System study — schools, records, rival theories, archives — and how accurate is it?
Which craft advantages are hoarded, by whom, and what is their real versus believed efficacy?
What relations exist with returning non-human peoples and other surviving human communities, whose histories and aims remain undeveloped here?
What harvest, preservation, trade, and shore practices of every kind later evidence can establish while WLD-ECOLOGY-006's mortality-channel-only boundary stands?
How does the settlement remember the collapse and its own founding, versus what WLD-HISTORY-001 establishes actually occurred?

author_approval.evidence: On 2026-08-17 the Author selected 'A — STRAND-BRAID' from the displayed multiple-choice options, accepting Option A exactly as drafted together with the proposal's shared claim set.
